sentences.en: For the first time in a long time, I'm in our office in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 这是很久以来我第一次回到位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心美丽的办公室。

sentences.en: A couple people actually still work here.
sentences.zh: 其实还有几个人在这里工作。

sentences.en: Two people can occupy the space without violating any social distancing guidelines.
sentences.zh: 两个人待在这个空间里，完全不会违反任何社交距离准则。

sentences.en: There's two entrances, there's two different bathrooms, there's two different kitchens.
sentences.zh: 这里有两个入口，两个不同的洗手间，还有两个不同的厨房。

sentences.en: I usually work at home, but today I'm here because our first book, The 99% Invisible City, has just been released into the world.
sentences.zh: 我通常在家办公，但今天我在这里，因为我们的第一本书《99%隐形城市》刚刚向世界发布了。

sentences.en: But since it's a guide to the city with stories and histories of the seemingly mundane things around you,
sentences.zh: 但因为它是一本关于城市的指南，讲述了你周围那些看似平凡事物的背后故事和历史，

sentences.en: my co-author Kurt Kolstad and I are going to use it to explore all the everyday objects right outside our own headquarters.
sentences.zh: 我和我的合著者库尔特·科尔斯塔德打算用它来探索我们总部外面的所有日常事物。

sentences.en: But before we even leave the office, just looking at the window, there's a brick building next door.
sentences.zh: 但在我们离开办公室之前，仅仅是看向窗外，隔壁就有一栋砖砌建筑。

sentences.en: And the tops of its walls are dotted with a bunch of square metal plates.
sentences.zh: 它的墙顶上点缀着一堆方形金属板。

sentences.en: These anchor plates are a few inches across, they're pretty thin, and they're spun in a bunch of different orientations.
sentences.zh: 这些锚固板有几英寸宽，非常薄，而且以各种不同的方向旋转着。

sentences.en: So, even though they're painted to blend in with a brick, once you notice them, they kind of stand out.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管它们被漆成了与砖块融为一体的颜色，但一旦你注意到它们，它们就会显得格外显眼。

sentences.en: And you can think of them like giant washers with bolts or rods tying them into the bricks,
sentences.zh: 你可以把它们想象成巨大的垫圈，用螺栓或杆子将它们固定在砖块里，

sentences.en: and helping brace them against the facade.
And these ones happen to be square, but I've seen others in the neighborhood that are round or octagonal.
sentences.zh: 这些刚好是方形的，但我在这附近见过其他圆形或八角形的。

sentences.en: In fact, anchor plates like this are pretty common in the Bay Area, in part for seismic reasons.
sentences.zh: 事实上，像这样的锚固板在湾区很常见，部分原因是出于地震考虑。

sentences.en: They help make sure that loose bricks don't fall off buildings and hurt people during earthquakes.
sentences.zh: 它们有助于确保松动的砖块不会在地震中从建筑物上掉落并伤害到人。

sentences.en: These particular ones are way up high where the walls overrun the roof.
sentences.zh: 这些特殊的锚固板位于墙体高出屋顶的地方。

sentences.en: So, there's a parapet up there where the bricks can't be braced against the main building.
sentences.zh: 那里有一个女儿墙，砖块无法靠在主建筑上进行支撑。

sentences.en: And so, someone installed these and connected them to metal braces on the rooftop that you can't actually see from below.
sentences.zh: 所以，有人安装了这些锚固板，并将它们连接到屋顶的金属支架上，你在下面其实是看不到的。

sentences.en: In other places, though, you can see anchor plates all the way down a facade.
sentences.zh: 不过在其他地方，你可以看到整面外墙上都布满了锚固板。

sentences.en: And in those cases, they have a ton of work to do.
sentences.zh: 在那些情况下，它们承担着巨大的作用。

sentences.en: They help hold up entire masonry walls that might otherwise be at risk of total collapse.
sentences.zh: 它们帮助支撑起整个砖石墙体，否则这些墙体可能会有彻底倒塌的风险。

sentences.en: In the book, we have an illustration with a bunch of different shapes that you can look out for in whatever city you're in.
sentences.zh: 在书中，我们有一张插图，展示了各种不同的形状，无论你在哪个城市，都可以留意一下。

sentences.en: There are squares and circles and stars and other geometric forms, but there are also some really ornate ones,
sentences.zh: 有方形、圆形、星形和其他几何形状，但也有一些非常华丽的，

sentences.en: like this huge curving S-shape that holds up an old stone wall in Europe.
sentences.zh: 比如欧洲那个支撑着古老石墙的巨大弯曲S形构件。

sentences.en: But whether they look good, or not so good, they've got a job to do.
sentences.zh: 但无论它们看起来好不好看，它们都有自己的工作要做。

sentences.en: And they all look better than the alternative, which would be, of course, a pile of stones or bricks.
sentences.zh: 而且它们看起来都比替代方案要好，当然，替代方案就是一堆石头或砖块。

sentences.en: So, if you walk outside of our building and look back, you will see a beautiful, black, ornate fire escape.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你走出我们的大楼回头看，你会看到一个漂亮、黑色、装饰精美的消防逃生梯。

sentences.en: I love that we have a fire escape on our building.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我们的大楼上有消防逃生梯。

sentences.en: I know a couple people on the staff, they climb out on it and watch the city at night.
sentences.zh: 我知道员工里有几个人会爬上去，在晚上看城市风景。

sentences.en: I never do that because I'm a big chicken.
sentences.zh: 我从不那样做，因为我是个胆小鬼。

sentences.en: Fire has long been one of the greatest existential threats to a building and its occupants,
sentences.zh: 长期以来，火灾一直是建筑物及其居住者面临的最大生存威胁之一，

sentences.en: but fire escapes became widespread kind of late in the game.
sentences.zh: 但消防逃生梯的普及其实比较晚。

sentences.en: Back in the 1700s, fire escapes weren't built-in features, but rather mobile ladders on carts hauled to blazes by firemen.
sentences.zh: 回到18世纪，消防逃生梯并不是内置设施，而是由消防员用马车拉到火灾现场的移动梯子。

sentences.en: Other solutions for escaping a fire in a multi-story building in the 1800s included parachute hats.
sentences.zh: 19世纪多层建筑逃生的其他方案还包括降落伞帽。

sentences.en: I think you can imagine both how those looked and how they did not work at all.
sentences.zh: 我想你可以想象出它们的样子，以及它们是如何完全不起作用的。

sentences.en: There was even this widely circulated plan that proposed that if there was a fire,
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一个广为流传的计划，提议如果发生火灾，

sentences.en: that archers from the ground would shoot arrows with ropes attached to them
sentences.zh: 地面上的弓箭手会射出带有绳索的箭，

sentences.en: for residents on the upper floors to shimmy down.
sentences.zh: 让高层的居民顺着绳子滑下来。

sentences.en: But eventually, we settled on iron fire escapes attached permanently to a building's facade.
sentences.zh: 但最终，我们选择了永久固定在建筑物外墙上的铁制消防逃生梯。

sentences.en: Fire escapes are thankfully not used very often,
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，消防逃生梯并不经常使用，

sentences.en: but unfortunately this also means that they can fall into disrepair,
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，这也意味着它们可能会年久失修，

sentences.en: especially if a landlord is prone to cutting corners.
sentences.zh: 尤其是如果房东倾向于偷工减料的话。

sentences.en: The infamous Triangle Shirtwaist factory fire that killed 146 people in 1911
sentences.zh: 1911年导致146人死亡的臭名昭著的三角内衣工厂火灾，

sentences.en: was a national tragedy that spurred a lot of change in terms of workers' rights,
sentences.zh: 是一场全国性的悲剧，推动了工人权利方面的许多变革，

sentences.en: but it also made people look closely at how we need safe and plentiful means of egress from buildings in case of emergency.
sentences.zh: 但也让人们密切关注我们需要在紧急情况下有安全且充足的建筑出口。

sentences.en: In this instance, one of the things that caused a lot of the deaths
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，导致大量死亡的原因之一，

sentences.en: was that the fire escape collapsed under the weight of all the people trying to flee for their lives.
sentences.zh: 就是消防逃生梯在所有试图逃生的人的重压下坍塌了。

sentences.en: managing the flow of people during an emergency is a top consideration.
sentences.zh: 在紧急情况下管理人员流动是一个首要考虑因素。

sentences.en: If you look around the city, most buildings don't seem to have fire escapes anymore.
sentences.zh: 如果你环顾城市，大多数建筑物似乎不再有消防逃生梯了。
较新的建筑物从来都没有。

sentences.en: These buildings, they do have fire escapes,

sentences.en: Fire stairs often double as ordinary staircases used on a daily basis,
sentences.zh: 消防楼梯通常兼作日常使用的普通楼梯，

sentences.en: but they have extra protections and features to make them safer routes of escape during emergencies.
sentences.zh: 但它们有额外的保护措施和功能，使它们成为紧急情况下更安全的逃生路线。

sentences.en: So you could be walking on the great-granddaughter of this fire escape every day and not even notice it.
